newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - February 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - February 3.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Monday's Daily Variety:
* The first installment of News Corp Ltd's 20th Century Fox's Star Wars Special Edition grossed an estimated $36.2 million for the weekend.

* Jonathan Pryce is in final talks to play the main villain in the next installment of the James Bond franchise, sources said. The untitled film is the 18th in the Bond series. Filming on the United Artists picture will begin April 1.

* Carlton, Granada and BSkyB are in a bid to launch 15 digital terrestrial channels in the Britain in the next year. The consortium is dubbed British Digital Broadcasting and is one of two bids competing for the right to offer digital terrestrial TV services from 1998. The rival bid comes from the American-owned cable firm Cabletel.

* In an effort to jumpstart its Friday night lineup and deal a blow to Disney Corp's ABC's still-strong TGIF franchise, the Eye web has plucked the Time Warner Inc's Warner Bros Television comedy Family Matters away from the Alphabet web.
